estimand: Exploratory channel-level spectra within complete 300-second recording-relative windows; no subject inference, no dose-relative interpretation
resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly; Kaiser beta 8.6; padtype line; each complete window independently, no interpolation of missing samples
integration: Piecewise linear PSD with interpolated exact band endpoints; no zero padding
channel_selection: All ECG100C and EGG100C channels separately; no averaging, no best-channel selection
invalid_windows: Nonfinite raw values are not filled; whole-constant raw windows retain flags without spectral ratios
spectral_interpretation: Descriptive only; gastric-band maximum not verified gastric rhythm; finite PSD does not pass artifact QC
